name: Ptolemy
source:
An astronomer sent from Macedonia to study the dark, cloud-covered Egyptian skies.

In order to avoid being disrespectful to the Egyptian people, she dressed in Egyptian clothing, learned Egyptian falconry techniques, and became an Egyptian citizen. She is trying her best to understand the greatness of Tutankhamun.
